<div class="explore-intro">
This library brings together research products developed with data from the SFA Camera Trap Project. It includes student posters, conference presentations, manuscripts, and published papers.

The goal is not only to document project outputs, but also to provide examples that future students can use when developing their own research questions, analyses, figures, and scientific posters.
</div>

::: {.soft-panel}
### For students

If this is your first research project or scientific poster, browse previous work for examples of how other students organized their questions, figures, results, and conclusions.

These materials are examples rather than templates that must be copied exactly.
:::

## Research library

At the moment, research products can be added as individual pages under:

```text
research/items/
```

Each project can include:

- a short abstract or project summary;
- authors and student presenters;
- conference or journal information;
- a photograph of the presenter or project;
- a downloadable poster or manuscript;
- links to a published article or external resource; and
- related survey or dataset information.

::: {.callout-note}
The research library will be populated as existing posters, presentations, and publications are added to the website.
:::
